recipes.name: Logo vectorizing: raster logo to layered SVG (and animated emblem)
recipes.communicates: The client's identity, built with motion (wings open, shield forms, pen element lands) without recolouring or inventing.
source: work/persian/src/film/uni/Logo.tsx (Emblem: loads layers at render time)

params.groups: ids left-wing, right-wing, shield, pen-element (Logo.tsx requires these); nested sub-layers wing-left, inner-left, wing-right, inner-right, arch, line, dot
params.viewBox: 0 0 1000 1000, spine at x=500, emblem space x221-779 / y70-930
params.layers_json: per layer bbox_vb, centre_vb, transform_origin_vb, draw_order, motion
params.colours: sampled from the source, never recoloured

recipes.regen: node generator was a scratchpad gen.mjs (not tracked): redraw by hand from the source image, see procedure below
procedure: 1. Ask for SVG/vector. If the user sends SVG: use as is (inspect for layers; split groups by hand if animation needs them).
2. Else raster: redraw by hand as layered SVG, one top-level group per animation part, colours sampled from the source pixels, symmetric parts mirrored from one half.
3. Write layers.json (bbox, centre, transform origin, draw order) so motion code needs no geometry guesses.

4. ACCEPTANCE (overlay difference, target below): rasterize the SVG at the source size, scale/pad to the source aspect, then ffmpeg -i source.png -i render.png -filter_complex "[0][1]blend=all_mode=difference,format=gray,signalstats" -f null - and read YAVG (mean difference, 0-255). Target to be set after the first calibration run: start with YAVG <= 12 on the logo area (about 5%); record the real number in the film's reuse ledger. Flag the logo as 'approximate' in the report if above target.
5. Visual side-by-side at 100% and 400% is still required (reviewer look): the numeric score alone does not catch missing small features.
6. Confidentiality: the layered files stay under the git-ignored uni-local/ folder; tracked code holds no path data.
recipes.script_to_build: work/persian/tools/logo-diff.mjs: rasterize SVG with headless Chrome via the Browser/puppeteer already used by Remotion (or Remotion's still renderer) to PNG, then run the ffmpeg blend=difference + signalstats command above, print mean difference and write a diff PNG. Not built in this change set (needs a calibrated threshold first).
pitfalls: Source low-res (189x267): scallops and pointed tips get simplified; document what differs
No rasterizer was available in the first run: acceptance was visual only; the numeric check is still unproven
Do not publish the layered logo of a client in tracked files

failed_or_open: numeric overlay score: to build, no number recorded yet
